blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police have launched a manhunt for the gunman behind an alleged shooting incident along a bypass road in Zamboanga City last Monday evening that left a local government worker dead. The victim, identified as Vivencio Villan Cruz Jr., 51, succumbed to gunshot wounds at 7:04 p.m. on Tuesday at the West Metro Medical Center, Major Sharfina Abdula, spokesperson for the Zamboanga City Police Office (ZCPO), said. Cruz formerly worked as an executive assistant to Zamboanga City Mayor Khymer Olaso and was assigned to the City Administrator’s Office. READ: Man shot dead in broad daylight on […]...
